CUSTOM LUXURY HOME BUILDERS MIAMI
TREO is a luxury residential homebuilder specializing in single-family home projects which require unparalleled levels of quality and service excellence to bring a client’s vision to life.
Headquartered in North Miami Beach, we partner with clients, architects, interior designers and engineering consultants to deliver the highest quality construction management services in South Florida’s luxury residential market.
Designing and building your own home is no small endeavor. Our approach emphasizes working collaboratively and communicating effectively so that, together, we create a custom home that tells our client’s story, is sensitive to context and place, and connects the inhabitants to their environment.

Quality and Craftsmanship
MIAMI LUXURY HOME BUILDERS
TREO Construction is a luxury home builder with a strong emphasis on quality craftsmanship. We set the highest standards for construction and our team’s expertise ensures that each project is completed on time and within budget. As one of the leading luxury custom home builders in Miami, we’re dedicated to building a strong partnership with each client.
We understand that building your own home can be a stressful process, but with TREO, you can rest easy knowing that we are the right fit for your needs. We guarantee to build your luxury home to your exact specifications without  compromising on quality.
Our Process
An Individual Approach 
To Building Your PERFECT HOME in Miami
The process of building your dream home is an exhilarating experience, and one that we take an astonishing amount of pride in guiding our clients through. Our approach is straightforward and transparent – and we wouldn’t have it any other way.
We don’t just build luxury homes; we make unique, custom designed luxury homes that perfectly reflect our client’s dreams and their architect’s intention. The results are testimony to our passion for creating the finest luxury homes in Miami. We treat every project with the utmost care and attention to detail.
We listen carefully so that we can turn your vision into reality. Each home has its own story and requires an individual approach to reveal the unique character of the family who will be residing in it.
With a vast amount of experience in our field, a strong work ethic, and a devotion to customer care, we’ve become one of Miami’s leading high-end residential home builders. And for good reason. We ensure our client’s expectations and deadlines are met on each and every project.

Services we offer for Custom Home Building
We’re proud to provide comprehensive construction solutions which meet the custom residential home building needs of the most discerning homeowners in Miami, FL. PROJECT MANAGEMENT
At TREO our projects are managed from conception through completion. That includes feasibility analysis and pre-construction meetings. During construction, we utilize the latest project management tools to keep you informed of every step. At TREO custom luxury home builders and commercial contractors, bringing a project in on time and within budget is a matter of pride and integrity.
DEVELOPMENT
TREO help developers deliver high-end residential projects, bringing the expertise required to execute complex designs and enhance overall project value. We focus on precision at every stage, ensuring each detail is built to the highest standard so developers can fully realize and maximize their investment.
Architect & Designer Collaboration
At TREO, we see ourselves as custodians of someone else’s vision — not just yours, but your architect’s, your interior designer’s, and your landscape architect’s too. Every set of drawings we’re handed represents months, sometimes years, of creative intent. Our job is to build that intent faithfully, without letting field decisions, budget pressure, or scheduling quietly erode it along the way.
This is why architects and designers trust TREO with their most demanding clients: we don’t compete with their vision. We build it.

What makes custom luxury home builders different from other builders?

Yes, home builders in Miami like TREO Construction manage every stage of the building process—from planning, permitting, and budgeting to construction, quality control, and final handover—providing clients with a stress-free experience and a home tailored to their vision.

High-end construction companies like TREO Construction are defined by exceptional craftsmanship, boutique levels of service, premium materials, meticulous attention to detail, and impeccable project management—delivering custom homes that reflect each client’s unique vision and uncompromising standards of luxury.

We coordinate closely with architects, manage permits, control budgets, and ensure timely delivery—creating contemporary homes that balance style, function, and durability for South Florida’s unique lifestyle and climate.

Custom home builders in Miami, Florida, serve prestigious areas including Miami, Miami Beach, Golden Beach, Bal Harbour, and Bay Harbor Islands—offering tailored luxury homes that reflect each community’s unique lifestyle, architecture, and coastal charm while delivering exceptional craftsmanship and personalized service.

A Miami custom home builder adapts to unique client requests through personalized design, flexible planning, and close collaboration with architects and designers. They tailor every detail—materials, layouts, and finishes—to match each client’s vision, ensuring a one-of-a-kind home that blends luxury, functionality, and South Florida’s lifestyle.
What should clients expect from luxury home contractors during construction?
During construction, clients can expect luxury home contractors to provide clear communication, detailed project management, strict quality control, and smooth coordination with architects and designers. They ensure timelines and budgets are met while delivering exceptional craftsmanship, premium finishes, and a stress-free construction experience tailored to the client’s vision.

Residential building developers are essential for large luxury projects because they oversee planning, financing, design coordination, and construction management. Their expertise ensures streamlined execution, cost efficiency, and timely delivery—transforming complex visions into high-quality, customized residences that meet the highest standards of luxury and client expectations.

High-end residential contractors improve the quality of a new home by using premium materials, employing skilled craftsmen, and maintaining rigorous quality control. Through meticulous attention to detail, innovative construction techniques, and strong collaboration with architects and designers, they deliver durable, functional, and beautifully finished homes that exceed client expectations.
What makes Florida luxury home builders a top choice for waterfront properties?
Florida luxury home builders are a top choice for waterfront properties because they specialize in designs that maximize views, enhance indoor-outdoor living, and withstand coastal conditions. With expertise in premium materials, custom layouts, and modern amenities, they create homes that combine elegance, durability, and the best of waterfront living.

Meet the TREO Construction Team
Our Leadership & Construction Management Team
 RICARDO HALFEN 
 Founder and CEO 
Ricardo Halfen – Founder & CEO
During more than 10 years he led one of the most important development and construction firms in Venezuela, where he managed the entire development process, from land acquisition to construction, and sales. Projects included the development of shopping centers, multi-family residential condominiums, and high-end residential projects. He relocated to Miami in 2009 and brought with him his expertise in development and construction.
He is currently a board member of: Inelectra, an engineering and construction company in the energy sector. Education: MBA from Columbia University, a MS. (Engineering Economic Systems) from Stanford University, and a BS (Economics) from the Universidad Católica Andres Bello.
 Eli Abadi 
 Partner and Operations Manager 
Eli Abadi - Partner & Operations Manager 
Eli was born in Caracas, Venezuela and moved to Toronto, Canada in 2010, where he completed his Civil Engineering degree and Engineering Business minor from the University of Toronto in 2015. While at school, he started his professional career with Holcim, one of the largest building material suppliers in the world. After working at Holcim for two years and completing his degree, Eli relocated to Miami and started working with Treo Construction.
At Treo, Eli is responsible for the construction operations of our multi-million dollar residential projects. He oversees the scheduling, budgeting and quality assurance stages of the construction activities and is in charge of all systems and communication with the different stakeholders to ensure a quality product at a competitive price.
 Ligia Maldonado 
 Controller 
Ligia Maldonado - Controller
Ligia was born in Peru where she completed her Accounting degree at the Universidad Hermilio Valdizan de Huanuco in 1988. After more than 10 years of accounting and auditing professional experience, she relocated to Miami in 2002 where continued her career experiences and served as a volunteer for the IRS Vita Program.
Ligia joined Treo in 2014, where she oversees all the accounting, employee management and human resources tasks at the firm.
 Mario Zambrano

With management responsibilities, he then continued his career working on important residential and commercial developments for 12 years. Mario graduated from the University of Carabobo as a Civil Engineer and has postgraduate studies in Construction Management. In 2018 he moved with his family from Valencia, Venezuela to Miami.

Gabriela was born and raised in Venezuela where she completed her Bachelor’s degree in Architecture at the Universidad Simón Bolívar and her Masters in Project Management at the Universidad Católica Andres Bello. Our Process - Treo Construction
Skip to content
OUR
PROCESS
Our approach to construction projects emphasizes working collaboratively with clients and their design teams, and communicating effectively so that we create spaces which tell our client’s story while helping them to establish a strong connection to their environment.
Precision and Care
You expect the best and we’re here to deliver it. We achieve this by adopting a tried-and-trusted approach which helps us meet – and often exceed – the highest standards for the most discerning clients. We have a passion for architectural design, vast experience of custom finishes, and a keen eye for detail. Our goal is to craft unique, luxurious homes that are tailored to the individual requirements of our clients through a process which places an emphasis on precision and customer care.
Step-by-Step Guide to Working with our Team
1
Initial Consultation
At our first meeting, we listen attentively as you talk through your overall goals, ideas, wants and needs. 
Once we have a clear understanding of your project, we’ll review the main planning and construction considerations together that will ensure your project’s success.
As part of our familiarization process, we can arrange for you to visit some of the properties we’ve built, and speak with owners who have worked with us so you get a clear idea of our approach and whether we’re the best team to deliver your project.
2
Pre-Construction
We begin this phase by reviewing the construction documents you have approved with your architect, and preparing a comprehensive scope of work based on the designs. This will inform the development of a preliminary budget and timing schedule which we’ll present to you in detail at a meeting usually held at our office.
If selected for your project, we’ll send a construction agreement to you, before getting started on detailed project planning and scheduling, with a sharp focus on preparing the site for construction work to begin.
3
Construction
The construction phase comprises:
Sitework: preparing the site for construction
Shell: constructing the outer building envelope and interior core
Dry-ins: the building envelope is completely weather-proof 
Roughs: mechanical, electrical, and plumbing lines
Interior and Exterior Finishes: that form a protective coating to the disclosed surface

4
Post Construction
With all of the hard work done, it’s time to move in!
Taking the keys to your new one-of-a-kind home is a very special moment, and signals the start of your family making your new house a home.

From Blueprints to Reality - Treo Construction
Skip to content
From Blueprints to Reality: The TREO Construction Monograph
From Blueprints to Reality is TREO Construction’s monograph — a richly photographed record of how ambitious architectural visions become livable, lasting works of art along Miami’s Gold Coast. Now in its 2nd Edition (2026), the book traces 13 exceptional residential projects — 8 completed homes and 5 currently under construction — across Golden Beach, Miami Beach, Bay Harbor Islands, the Venetian Islands, and other Miami-Dade communities.
Each project profile documents the layered coordination between architect, engineer, interior designer, and builder that makes these homes possible, featuring the work of architecture firms including SDH Studio Architecture + Design, [STRANG], Oppenheim Architecture, and Preschel Bassan Studio, alongside TREO Construction Founder & CEO Ricardo Halfen and the TREO team.
"What's inside"
13 residential projects — 8 completed, 5 currently under construction
Locations — Golden Beach, Miami Beach, Bay Harbor Islands, the Venetian Islands, and other Miami-Dade communities
Collaborating architecture firms — SDH Studio Architecture + Design, [STRANG] Design, Oppenheim Architecture, Preschel Bassan Studio
Focus — behind-the-scenes narrative on how architect, engineer, interior designer, and builder coordinate to deliver each home
Edition — 2nd Edition, published July 2026
Read the full monograph above, or explore TREO’s 
project portfolio
and 
press coverage
 for more on our work across Miami-Dade.
FAQ's
What is TREO Construction's monograph, "From Blueprints to Reality"?
It's a richly photographed monograph published by TREO Construction (2nd Edition, 2026) documenting 13 luxury residential projects across Miami's Gold Coast — 8 completed and 5 under construction — showing how the collaboration between architect, engineer, interior designer, and builder brings each home to life.
How many projects are featured in the book?
Thirteen residential projects in total: eight completed homes and five currently under construction, located in Golden Beach, Miami Beach, Bay Harbor Islands, the Venetian Islands, and other Miami-Dade communities.
Which architecture firms are featured alongside TREO Construction?
The monograph showcases collaborations with SDH Studio Architecture + Design, [STRANG], Oppenheim Architecture, and Preschel Bassan Studio.
Is TREO Construction a design-build firm?
No. TREO is a builder that works collaboratively with each client's own architect, engineer, and interior designer — the same partnership model documented throughout the monograph — rather than operating as a single design-build entity.
Where can I view the TREO Construction monograph?
The full monograph is embedded at the top of this page and can only be read online. For a copy of the book, call us on (305) 851-2130 and request a copy (available while stocks last).
